'''Mosrk'tecks''' were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] which looked like large, flattened [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]]. They were typically two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, not including the tail. They were highly-effective predators and were considered at the top of the food chain on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
